invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破70000（支撑位），或融资费率Z-score回升至-20%以上（轧空动力消失）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 70000 (support level), or funding Z-score rises above -20% (short squeeze momentum fades).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.092（ATR支撑），或资金费率Z-score转正（空头压力缓解）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.092 (ATR support), or funding Z-score turns positive (short pressure eases).
